result.stdout:
Description:
  Run the AI.Sentinel detector pipeline against a saved conversation.

Usage:
  AI.Sentinel.Cli scan <file> [options]

Arguments:
  <file>  Path to the conversation file (OpenAI JSON or AI.Sentinel audit NDJSON).

Options:
  --format <AuditNdjson|Auto|OpenAIChatCompletion>  Conversation format. [default: Auto]
  --output <Json|Text>                              Output format. [default: Text]
  --expect <expect>                                 Detector IDs that must fire (repeatable).
  --min-severity <Critical|High|Low|Medium|None>    Minimum required max severity.
  --baseline <baseline>                             Path to a prior ReplayResult JSON for regression comparison.
  --compliance                                      Also run the opt-in Art. 5 compliance detectors CMP-01 to CMP-04. SENTINEL_HOOK_COMPLIANCE=on does the same.
  --max-scan-bytes <max-scan-bytes>                 The most UTF-8 bytes of new content scanned per turn; larger content is reported as SEC-00. Default: 262144.
  -?, -h, --help                                    Show help and usage information

Description:
  Browse the local audit file in the AI.Sentinel dashboard.

Usage:
  AI.Sentinel.Cli dashboard [options]

Options:
  --db <db>                            Path to the audit SQLite file. Defaults to the file the hooks and the MCP proxy write. [default: /tmp/inspectra-help-aisent-b29c1c5c-ba9d549b/xdg-data/ai-sentinel/audit.db]
  --port <port>                        Port to listen on, on the --bind address (127.0.0.1 by default). Use 0 for any free port. [default: 5170]
  --bind <bind>                        IP address to listen on. Anything but loopback needs --trusted-proxy. [default: 127.0.0.1]
  --approval-config <approval-config>  Path to the approval config JSON. Defaults to SENTINEL_APPROVAL_CONFIG when set.
  --trusted-proxy <trusted-proxy>      CIDR range or address of a reverse proxy whose user header is trusted. Repeatable.
  --user-header <user-header>          Header the trusted proxy sets to the authenticated user name. [default: X-Auth-Request-User]
  --local-approver                     Let the local operator approve and deny as the current OS user. Loopback only, no proxy.
  --public-host <public-host>          Host name or IP address the trusted proxy forwards in the Host header. Repeatable. localhost is always accepted.
  -?, -h, --help                       Show help and usage information

Description:
  Build a compliance report from the local audit file.

Usage:
  AI.Sentinel.Cli report [options]

Options:
  --db <db>                Path to the audit SQLite file. Defaults to the file the hooks and the MCP proxy write. [default: /tmp/inspectra-help-aisent-b29c1c5c-ba9d549b/xdg-data/ai-sentinel/audit.db]
  --from <from>            Start of the period: an ISO date (yyyy-MM-dd, from 00:00 UTC) or an ISO 8601 timestamp. Defaults to 30 days before --to.
  --to <to>                End of the period, inclusive: an ISO date (yyyy-MM-dd, to the end of that UTC day) or an ISO 8601 timestamp. Defaults to now.
  --format <html|json|md>  Output format: md, html or json. [default: md]
  --output <output>        File to write the report to. Defaults to standard output.
  -?, -h, --help           Show help and usage information
